candidates.name: Palazzo dei Normanni
candidates.content: The oldest royal residence in Europe, the home of the rulers of the Kingdom of Sicily and imperial seat of the Emperor Frederick II. The palace contains the Cappella Palatina, the best example of the Arab-Norman style of Sicily. N

candidates.name: Palermo Cathedral
candidates.content: Honey-coloured and Catalan influenced. Frederick II, Barbarossa's grandson, died in 1250 and is buried here, far from his ancestral home above Hohenstaufen, Germany. Frederick's sarcophagus is of porphyry dyed with imperial purple

candidates.name: San Giovanni degli Eremiti
candidates.content: Church notable for its brilliant red domes, which show the persistence of the Arab influences in the 12th century, with its typical Arab-Norman style. The €6 admission ensures that the lovely garden is quiet and peaceful.

candidates.name: Church of the Gesù
candidates.content: The Gesu Church is one of the most architecturally important in Palermo. Constructed between 1564–1633, its late date of completion resulted in an abundant use of polychrome marbles on both floors and walls. This form of decoratio

candidates.name: Piazza Pretoria and the Fontana Pretoria
candidates.alt: also known as square of Shame
candidates.content: In 1573 the Senate of Palermo bought a fountain intended for the Palace of San Clemente in Florence, with the intention of placing it in the square. The large central fountain is the focal point for 16 nude statues of nymphs, huma

candidates.name: Praetorian Palace or Palace of the Eagles
candidates.alt: Palazzo Pretorio or Palazzo delle Aquile
candidates.content: The building has an important role in the political life of the city, since it houses the mayor and the offices of the municipality of Palermo. Construction began in 1463. It is open for visits to see the sumptuous meeting rooms,

candidates.name: Monreale
candidates.content: A village 8 km west of Palermo, sitting on the hill with a great view back towards the city and the sea. It is home to a historical Norman-Byzantine cathedral, which has been designated as one of several buildings named in a

candidates.name: Monreale Cathedral
candidates.content: The cathedral of Monreale is one of the greatest extant examples of Norman architecture. It was begun in 1174 by William II and completed four years later. The church is a national monument of Italy and one of the most important a

candidates.name: Palatine Chapel
candidates.price: included in the Normans palace tickets
candidates.content: It's one of the artistic gems of Palermo: a chapel with magnificent mosaics and Arabian-style decorations, among the most beautiful in the world. It is inside of Palazzo dei Normanni.

candidates.name: Catacombe dei Cappuccini
candidates.content: The catacombs of the Capuchin convent contain over 8,000 mummified ex-residents from Palermo and its surrounding villages, some merely clothed skeletons, other remarkably well-preserved and lifelike. Well worth a visit, interestin

candidates.name: Museo delle Maioliche (Museum of Maiolica Tile)
candidates.content: Beautiful private museum of historical tiles produced both locally and in Naples. Guided tours available in English or Italian will take you through the techniques and historical considerations of tile making and its importance ac

candidates.name: Palermo Botanical Garden
candidates.hours: Opens at 09:00, closes at different times based on the season (e.g. 17:00 in winter, 20:00 in summer)
candidates.content: Historical city botanical gardens featuring many collections of plants, trees, and aquaculture. The garden is associated with the neighbouring university and contains a number of experimental gardens to test acclimation of plant s

candidates.name: The Bar Brothers
candidates.content: Great little bar for beers and cocktails. A small number of seats out on the street. Beers from €2.50 to 3.50.

candidates.name: dal Barone
candidates.content: Nice wine bar with a good selection of wines. Good cheeseboards.

candidates.name: Pani câ Meusa – Porta Carbone
candidates.content: The best sandwiches. Excellent typical Palermo food. A dining experience to try these local Street food delicacies.

candidates.name: Timilia
candidates.content: Very good pizzeria, a real delight. Also Vegan options. For those intolerant to gluten and lactose, the pizzas are gluten-free and the mozzarella is lactose-free.

candidates.name: Bisso Bistrot
candidates.content: Bistro in the centre of Palermo with a wide choice of vegetarian and vegan dishes. Beautiful restaurant, with retro air, very unique old bookstore. Smiling waitress, very good food, decent waiting time.

candidates.name: 100 Montaditos
candidates.content: Many types of sandwiches, all very good. You have to fill in the order sheet and go to the cashier to pay, then the dishes ordered on the sheet arrive. Each sandwich is €1.

candidates.name: Le Tabarin
candidates.content: Magical Palermo atmosphere with a background of 1990s/2000s music. One of the best apericena: tasty limoncello Spritz, tasty fresh food, big amount per person.

candidates.name: Osteria dei Vespri
candidates.content: This location has a certain charm, with a quite rare calm in Palermo. The service is impeccable. The vegetarian menu was really good. Delicious wines and fantastic food!

candidates.name: Stuzzicandoci
candidates.content: Best place to eat a delicious arancina in Palermo downtown. The owner is really kind and friendly. Quality ingredients and courteous staff.

candidates.name: Maqueda Bistrot
candidates.content: Great place, very delicious pasta and the bruschetta with the mozarella is tasty. They serve both pasta and great burgers.

candidates.name: Vecchia Trattoria da Totò
candidates.content: The real Palermo cuisine. Informal trattoria with tables also outdoors. Good mixed fried food, excellent mussels. No English menu.

candidates.name: Il Proverbio
candidates.content: Discesa dei Giudici, 24. Close to station and Quattro Canti. Great Sicilian food, most dishes are €4-6.

candidates.name: Bangla Fast Food
candidates.content: Delicious Indian/Bangladeshi food. Great veg curry, daal and rice for €4. A good selection of samosas and pakoras. Excellent chai for €1.

candidates.name: Cala Pollo & Co.
candidates.content: In this deli you will find one of the best chicken that the city can offer. Yummy food. Best Italian style BBQ chicken.

candidates.name: Mercato di Ballarò
candidates.content: Busy food market in Albergheria.
